offstage.note: Exposes offstage_doctor / offstage_route / offstage_run / offstage_probe for THIS repository, once `npm ci` has built dist/ (the prepare script does that). The path is relative to the project root, which is where Claude Code starts a project-scoped server. To use offstage from any directory instead, register it globally against a built clone: claude mcp add offstage --scope user -- node /absolute/path/to/offstage/dist/mcp/index.js
